title: Alphabet Seeks $25 Bn In Bond Sale Amid Investor Scrutiny of AI Investments
description: Alphabet Inc is seeking to raise as much as $25 billion through a fresh US investment-grade bond offering, in a deal that is expected to gauge investor appetite for debt issued to support artificial intelligence-related spending. The final size of the offering has not yet been determined, as per a report by Bloomberg. The Google and YouTube parent has also informed investors through the banks managing the issue that it intends to tap the US debt market twice a year, a move seen as addressing concerns over a steady supply of technology-sector bonds, the report said.
